name: ranki-ai
description: Read SEO and GEO research, content plans, and existing articles from your Ranki.ai account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Ranki.ai account to view your SEO and GEO workspaces, review saved keyword and competitor research, browse your content calendar, and read existing articles in ChatGPT. The integration provides read-only access to your account.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the keyword opportunities in my saved research.

positive.description: With a signed-in test account containing a populated workspace. List workspaces
positive.prompt: Which websites are in my Ranki.ai account?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only workspaces provided by the signed-in account.

positive.description: With a signed-in test account containing a populated workspace. Read saved research
positive.prompt: Summarize the competitor and keyword research for my selected workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected workspace ID and summarize only the saved snapshot.

positive.description: With a signed-in test account containing a populated workspace. Read the calendar
positive.prompt: Show up to three planned items from my selected workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected workspace ID and limit 3; show only returned entries.

positive.description: With a signed-in test account containing a populated workspace. List articles
positive.prompt: Which articles are available in my selected workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected workspace ID and list only articles returned.

positive.description: With a signed-in test account containing a populated workspace. Read an article
positive.prompt: Open the first article you just listed and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the workspace ID and the first returned article ID or slug.

negative.prompt: Generate a new article for my workspace.
negative.description: Explain that this connector can read existing articles. Do not call tools or claim a new article was created.

negative.prompt: Publish my latest article to WordPress.
negative.description: Explain that publishing is unavailable in the connector. Do not call tools or claim a publication.
Explain that deletion is unavailable in the connector. Do not call tools or claim deletion.

publication.release_notes: Adds read-only access to Ranki.ai workspaces, research, calendars and articles, with the Ranki.ai brand icon.
